items.t: Introduced a motion to reform Measure ULA.
items.q: Today, Councilmember Nithya Raman introduced a motion to reform Measure ULA and ensure that it continues to meet its stated goal: protecting tenants and building affordable housing.

items.t: Introduced a motion in 2021 calling for options for a ballot measure to update the City Charter to create Independent Redistricting Commissions for the City and the Los Angeles Unified School District.
items.q: Councilmember Raman introduced a motion in 2021, following the district’s experience during the redistricting process, calling for options for a ballot measure to be prepared for an election in 2024, or sooner, to update the City Charter to create Independent Redistricting Commissions
